title: Mystery
signature_image: A bowed traveler before an empty golden center circled by leaf, water, flame, and stars
final_ending: He bowed to what no name could hold.

title: Pervading
signature_image: A measuring cord dwarfed by a pale current flowing through living and inert forms

title: Shared
signature_image: Two quarreling neighbors drinking from opposite sides of one clay water pot while Mankuthimma steadies it between them
final_ending: Who taught shared breath to become hatred?

title: Between
signature_image: Mankuthimma standing between the rubble of a familiar house and the bare foundations of an unfinished new one
final_ending: The world waited, homeless between its certainties.

title: Beyond
signature_image: Resting animals beside a worn circular market path while Mankuthimma keeps circling with tomorrow's empty bowl
final_ending: Had all that striving carried him farther?

title: Grace
signature_image: Former rivals holding a storm-battered canopy stitched from mismatched cloth as rain drenches the laughing wayfarer

title: Stand
signature_image: Mankuthimma's open hand gently lifting a merchant's cheating thumb from a tilted brass grain scale
final_ending: The scale stayed level after he walked on.

title: Afloat
signature_image: Mankuthimma chest-deep in a broad river, giving a guava with one open hand and receiving a rope with the other
final_ending: Untroubled, he moved onward within the whole.

title: Homeward
signature_image: A bandaged foot facing one warm window in a tiny village beneath immense blue Meru
final_ending: That memory gave one more step.
